acceptance_gate_results.principle: Unsafe or unavailable dependencies cannot contribute numeric readiness.
Every named lifecycle boundary must pass once from durable evidence.
A reference is evidence only while its exact bytes and event count match.
The sidecar boundary must reject byte changes and lost events.
Readiness requires the production call sites, not only the ledger class.
Cleanup is complete only after every task-owned child stops.
The emitter repair must retain the original critical findings.
Historical fixture bytes must not become current inference evidence.
Every named affected, coverage, static, e2e, and terminal check must pass.

selfparse_call_arguments.timeout_s: minimum of proposer timeout and remaining bounded session time

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Actual current executable model identities; historical identities remain in sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Every check has expected, observed, passed, and a one-line principle explaining its purpose.
field_principles.arc_receipt_ready_score: One only for an unquarantined emitter and reachable live wrapper with passing lifecycle controls.
field_principles.caller_handoff: Exact caller paths, arguments, and code hashes bind the following live invocation.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure total elapsed and disjoint phase spans including failed work.
field_principles.execution_venue: Record actual host/device work; a CPU replay is not GPU or FPGA execution.
field_principles.fixture_sidecar_manifest: Fixture event bytes remain auditable without claiming current model work.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* names upstream/check, exact field, observed value, and expected value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_ or complete:; external failure starts blocked_. State the finding.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe actual computation with a recognized literal, not intended work.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Full generation has a 60s floor; bounded generation 10s; load-only 2s. Never pad time.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed, failed, cancelled, and in-flight loads and generations.
field_principles.lifecycle_control_rows: Every failure boundary and its true completed/in-flight counts must be represented.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any attempted model load or generation, even when output is unusable.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hash real inputs and record actual availability and failed checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Seal development and independent evaluation seeds before seeing outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, inputs, config, model when used, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Record every comparative unit/arm with metrics, costs, errors, abstentions, and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260914 with actual UTC start/end and monotonic phase timing.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Keep planned, attempted, complete, and censored counts with the frozen stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the record while keeping ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate producer identity, terminal class, and quarantine state.
field_principles.status: Write the terminal result only after the work and checks; checkpoints remain separate.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record exact commands, scope, exit codes, elapsed time, and log hashes; retain failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished own work is partial; unchanged external failure is blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Shared evaluator authority permits circular_positive only, not positive scientific value.

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: run each frozen CPU lifecycle control once; do not extend from outcomes
